title: PLAYER 2'S SCREEN CLEAR CLEARS THE SCREEN
why: Player 2 picks up power-ups from his own kills, and a SCREEN CLEAR is one in ten of them. In his window the clear sends each machine on his screen to the host as a blow of 9,999, so the host kills it. The host throws away any blow over 1,500 as a broken number, so not one machine died: player 2 saw the pulse and the sparks and every machine walked on. The same blows were counted into his air strike meter as damage he had dealt, and his window never paid the flat SCREEN CLEAR figure. Proven in headless Chromium with a linked pair: three crawlers on player 2's screen, his clear sent 9999 three times, the host answered bad three times, the crawlers kept full health, and his meter rose from 0 to 156. The clear now sends a blow the host takes (what the machine has left, at most 1,500), marked as a clear, so the host kills them and, as for player 1, the kills are nobody's (no streak, no kill), the blow charges no air strike meter, and he is paid the same flat thirty a machine up to four hundred.
now: Player 2's screen clear now kills the machines on his screen, as player 1's does.
